children: Ondo has expanded its smart portfolio product line to Solana. According to Foresight News, all seven portfolios are now available to eligible investors outside the United States and can be traded through major Solana wallets and apps. Three portfolios use strategies developed for Ondo by BlackRock, while the other four are Ondo-designed on-chain portfolios built around popular market themes, including large-cap technology companies and AI.

title: Ondo Expands Smart Portfolio Lineup to Solana
